product_metadata.title: Immersion Hand Blender Electric 2021 Upgrade, OBERLY 500W Smart Stepless 3-in-1 Heavy Duty Handheld Stick Mixer, Stainless Steel Blade with Milk Frother, Egg Whisk for Coffee Foam, Smoothies and Puree
features: Powerful and Fast: The immersion blender has a high powered 500 Watt motor to handle more blending tasks quietly. Thanks to its heavy duty and compact construction, it can fit in most mixing bowls, pots and beakers. It is ideal for frozen fruits and small ices cube.

Multiple Funtional: The removable blending arm with fixed blade locks into the motor body for easy operation. The brushed 304 stainless steel fixed blade quickly blends ingredients for making soups, smoothies, meringues, dips, sauces, mayo, chutney, whipped cream, salsa, baby food, guacamole & batters for baking.

Smart Stepless Speed Control: The immersion blender offers you extremely variable speed control of easy finger press to change speed, which makes it more convenient and stable in the operation process. Simple speed control for single button use. Perfect crushing, stirring or juicing can be achieved through variable speed adjustment.

Milk Frother Attachment: The milk frother make rich, creamy froth in seconds. We coffee lovers are serious when it comes to our coffee. It gives that professional finishing touch to your latte, cappuccino, macchiato or hot chocolate. The benefits of having your own electric drink whisk mixer are endless, you can make your own best latte, you know your tastes best.

Egg Whisk Attachment: The egg whisk is perfect for whisking up sauces, vinaigrettes, homemade mayonnaise, batters, and custards. The classic French whisk handles a variety of kitchen tasks effortlessly.
